An [[Aeosian]] [[Gender|female]] served as the '''queen''' of her [[species]] on her [[homeworld]] of [[Aeos Prime]]. In the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]], her [[planet]] housed a [[Aeos Prime rebel outpost|rebel outpost]], which was later [[Attack on Aeos Prime|attacked]] by the [[First Order]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. Not long after the attack, the queen met with representatives of the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[space station]], including [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Griff Halloran]], who wished to find a safe haven on Aeos Prime. The queen was initially hesitant to allow outsiders on her world due to the First Order attack, but eventually allowed the station to remain on the planet.

==Biography==
In the days of the [[Galactic Civil War]], in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] fought the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Aeosian]] [[queen]] allowed a [[Aeos Prime rebel outpost|rebel outpost]] to exist on her [[planet]]. Many [[Standard year|years]] later, long after the outpost was abandoned, an Aeosian [[Unidentified Aeosian village|village]] was [[Attack on Aeos Prime|attacked]] by the [[First Order]], due to the presence of the former rebel outpost, and several Aeosians were wounded or [[Death|killed]] in the attack.<ref name="The New World" />
[[File:AeosianQueen-TheNewWorld.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The queen points her scepter at her captives.]]
Sometime after the attack, the [[space station]] ''[[Colossus]]'' arrived on Aeos Prime, seeking refuge from the First Order. During a [[scout]]ing expedition [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Griff Halloran]], entered the destroyed village. While exploring the planet's [[cave]]s, Halloran, Xiono, and their [[droid]]s were captured by the [[Homeworld|native]] Aeosians and brought before the queen. The queen ordered that the prisoners be fed to the [[krakavora]], ignoring Xiono's attempts to explain their purpose on Aeos Prime. On their way to the krakavora, Xiono and the droid [[CB-23]] escaped so that Xiono could provide medicine to Aeosians who had been wounded in the First Order's attack. Realizing that her prisoners were not a threat, the queen offered to free them in exchange for further supplies of medicine.<ref name="The New World" />

The queen, along with a number of Aeosians and her former prisoners, boarded the ''Colossus'' and met with the station's [[captain]], [[Imanuel Doza]]. The queen agreed to allow the station to remain on Aeos Prime,<ref name="The New World" /> though the ''Colossus'' would later be discovered by the First Order.<ref name="No Place Safe">{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aeosian queen first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' episode "[[The New World]]," voiced by [[Lucy Lawless]].<ref name="The New World" />
